objective: XLSX and PPTX files are detected as Word documents. server/services/documents/formats.ts ~L50 returns DOCX when the head includes '[Content_Types].xml' or 'word/', and every OOXML package starts with [Content_Types].xml, so a workbook or presentation is sent to mammoth and fails instead of being honestly UNSUPPORTED (CLAUDE.md §9). Fix: require a word/ part (search the first 4 KB and the ZIP central directory in the last ~64 KB, since entry order is not guaranteed); return UNSUPPORTED with an xlsx/pptx reason when xl/ or ppt/ is present.
expectedOutcome: Only real Word packages are detected as DOCX; spreadsheets and presentations are UNSUPPORTED with a reason.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/documentFormatOoxml.test.ts (fixtures built with jszip): a package with xl/workbook.xml and one with ppt/presentation.xml both return UNSUPPORTED.
An existing DOCX fixture from tests/fixtures still returns DOCX.
Existing document extraction tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
